# Nemau Cloud Provider

The Nemau Cloud provider manages compute, network, load balancing, storage,
managed Kubernetes and DNS resources on [Nemau Cloud](https://nemau-cloud.com).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nemau = {
      source  = "nemau-cloud/nemau"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The credential comes from NEMAU_ACCESS_KEY_ID and NEMAU_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET,
# and the project from NEMAU_PROJECT_ID or from the credential.
provider "nemau" {}
```

## Configuration

Each argument of the `provider` block has an environment variable. An argument
set in the block takes precedence over its variable. Keep secrets in the
environment rather than in a `.tf` file.

| Environment variable | Argument | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NEMAU_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | `access_key_id` | Access key id |
| `NEMAU_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET` | `access_key_secret` | Access key secret |
| `NEMAU_TOKEN` | `token` | Service-account token |
| `NEMAU_PROJECT_ID` | `project` | Id of the target project |
| `NEMAU_API_URL` | `api_url` | API origin, `https://api.nemau-cloud.com` by default |

## Authentication

The provider authenticates with an IAM access key or with a service-account
token. When both are set, the access key is used.

Prefer an access key, because a service-account token is valid for 15 minutes
and can expire in the middle of a long apply. Access keys expire too: the
console issues them for 90 days unless you choose another date (365 days at
most), and the API answers `401` after that date. Rotate the key before it
expires.

## Project

The organization always comes from the credential. The project comes from
`project` when it is set, and from the credential otherwise. One credential can
manage several projects through one `alias` configuration per project. See the
[project selection guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/nemau-cloud/nemau/latest/docs/guides/project-selection).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String) IAM access key id. Defaults to `NEMAU_ACCESS_KEY_ID`. A key expires 90 days after creation unless its owner chose another date (365 days at most): rotate it before then.
- `access_key_secret` (String, Sensitive) Access key secret. Defaults to `NEMAU_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET`.
- `api_url` (String) API origin. Defaults to `NEMAU_API_URL`, then `https://api.nemau-cloud.com`.
- `project` (String) Id of the project every resource in this configuration acts on. Defaults to `NEMAU_PROJECT_ID`, then to the project the credential carries. A service account pinned to a project cannot use another one: the API answers 403.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Service-account token. Defaults to `NEMAU_TOKEN`. It expires after 15 minutes, so prefer an access key for long runs.
